hook: Khaali tijori mein pade phone par call aaya... 'Late Nani'!
feedback: Great cold open and distinct Chettinad aesthetic. To make the emotional core hit even harder before the climax, flesh out Cut 4 slightly to emphasize Ananya's deep respect/affection for Nani or her curiosity about Nani's disappearance so the reveal in Cut 14 carries maximum emotional weight.
lines: Khaali tijori mein pade phone par call aaya... 'Late Nani'!
Ananya ki saansen darr se tham gain.
Chettinad ki is haveli mein Amavas ki raat bhaari baarish ho rahi thi.
Ananya pehli baar apne pati ke is pushtaini ghar aayi thi.
Sabne kaha tha... Nani ki is peetal tijori ko kabhi mat kholna.
Lekin raat ke do baje... tijori se rone ki awaaz aayi.
Ananya ne ghabraakar mez se purani chaabi uthai.
Bhaari zang laga taala ek jhatke mein khul gaya!
Tijori bilkul khaali thi... andar koi nahi tha!
Sirf farsh par ek modern smartphone baj raha tha.
Beta, peeche hato... tijori band karo!
Nani ne khandani shraap ko kaid karne ke liye khud ko lock kar liya tha.
Aur aaj... wo taala hameesha ke liye toot chuka tha.
